fields.title: Macan After-Sales Field-Quality Analytics
fields.summary: A university project conducted in collaboration with Porsche, focused on identifying and prioritizing field-quality patterns from diagnostic trouble-code data in the Macan after-sales context.
fields.contribution: I developed the co-occurrence analysis and was one of two members who presented the results of our six-person team to Porsche's After-Sales and Data Science teams. The project received the Best Data Insight Award.
fields.technologies:
Co-occurrence Analysis
DTC Data
Field Quality

fields.title: Explaining Explainable AI for Stakeholders
fields.summary: A master seminar project with ING examining how explainable artificial intelligence can communicate model behavior to different stakeholder groups.
fields.contribution: I built a neural network, implemented SHAP-based explanations, developed a UI prototype, and presented the project results.

fields.title: Enhancing Anomaly Detection in Object-Centric Process Mining through Novel Feature Engineering
fields.summary: Research into feature-engineering approaches for anomaly detection in object-centric process mining.
fields.contribution: I investigated whether novel feature-engineering approaches could improve anomaly detection in object-centric process mining.
fields.technologies:
Process Mining
Feature Engineering
Anomaly Detection
